webster.text: Almighty; possessing unlimited power; all powerful.

example.quote: How are two legislatures to coincide, with powers transcendent, supreme, and omnipotent? for such is the definition of a legislature.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 11, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
